topic: The bicycle: from the wooden running machine to an electric bike

episode.title: Bicycle Evolution: Wooden Wheels to Electric Power

episode.description: Two wheels, two centuries of change—from the wooden running machine to today's electric bicycle. Flash-cut through the evolution. #BicycleEvolution #CyclingHistory #ElectricBike #ThenAndNow #EvolutionOf
